name: Bento Widget
summary: Generic bento-grid card whose 4 corners independently dock, round, or flow into neighboring widgets, resizable to any grid cell size.
description: One generic widget rather than several typed variants — content differs via component properties, corner treatment differs via 4 independent instance-swap slots (see the Corner component). Built to support widgets placed edge-to-edge on a bento grid that later animate into their final docked corner combination.

Expanded.note: Toggles visibility of the 'Expanded Content' panel only — does NOT resize the card automatically. See growthChoreography.

Has Image.note: Toggles a full-bleed background Image + Image Scrim layer, for photo-backed content (map preview, camera-trap photo, habitat photo). Completing a photo widget needs 3-4 manual per-instance steps since booleans can't drive a fill/text-color/corner-color change — see photoWidgets below.

photoWidgets: Has Image=true only toggles visibility of the Image/Image Scrim layers. Manual per-instance completion steps: (1) set the Image rectangle's own fill to the real photo, (2) override Title/Value/Description AND the Icon instance's fill to text/onEmphasis for legibility over the photo, (3) hide Value if the content has no number (e.g. a habitat card), (4) if a Fill/Concave corner is also used on this widget, its color must be manually sampled from the photo near that corner — the automatic Color/Widget Accent sync only works for flat-color widgets, there's no single accent color to bind to for a photo. Corner treatment was intentionally restricted to 'manual sample per instance' rather than building automatic photo-cropping into the Corner atom (user decision — simpler, consistent with how Concave already works).

states.Default: bg/subtle fill (via Color/Widget Accent variable, Default mode), no stroke.
states.Selected: border/focus (yellow) fill instead of bg/subtle. No stroke — an earlier version used a 2px inside stroke, which was shifting all content by the stroke weight; removed in favor of a solid fill so Default and Selected are pixel-identical in content position.

growthChoreography: The card's height stays FIXED at all times. Figma cannot make one instance react to another's property change, so growing a card and shifting its neighbors is always an explicit step (scripted or by hand): when Expanded is set true, also grow that instance's height by a clean 30px-grid multiple (Expanded Content panel is authored at 78px + 12px itemSpacing = 90px, one step) and shift any widget flush against its bottom edge down by that same amount. Worked example: 'Test: Bento Docking (Expand Choreography)'.
tokenFixesMadeHere: text/onEmphasis was found resolving to gray/900 (dark) in both Light and Dark mode — backwards from its documented purpose (text that contrasts an emphasis/dark fill, e.g. a photo). It had never been exercised until the photo-widget test surfaced it. Fixed at the token source to alias gray/50 (white) in both modes.
